notes.title: The Solitude Project Release + graphics explanation
notes.notes:
now i am going to release it fr

here are some explanation about the new "psycho" graphics mode

every graphic mode (from low to high) uses lumen and partial ray tracing for lightning (lightning bounces, shadows and AO). But, the new graphical modes "epic" and extreme "psycho" uses lumen and FULL RT for lightning. (epic uses full rt but with low quality samples, and psycho uses hq samples for full rt)

here are some images from level 2: 

High (n_frt.png)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809360/9c985b9c9bbd0b03c7d0edc01fcef6dd9ce27c8a.png
As you can see, the shadows from emissive lights doesnt fit the wall at all, it looks blurry and low quality.
And, the lightning is "strange", its yellowish, not that realistic, and with almost no AO at all in the brighter areas.

Psycho (frt.png)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809360/895050feb4f0cb73c749bfc4d56bd16d7f0b0427.png
Much better! The shadows now fit the walls, and the lightning is now more realistic, with more bounces. 
And RTAO is now better!

High (n_frt1.png)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809360/99c9f68b102dc72dbc6b3cfbb804d3034fb4298a.png
Same thing, the shadows dont fit the scene emissive light, and AO only works in dark areas.

Psycho (frt1.png)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809360/fcbac547727b4e6bdaa9facb50607253bb15f506.png
Shadows now fit better with the scene, and now lightning bounces in the water with more precision. AO is also improved.

notes.title: News About the Game Release (The Solitude Project)!! (And a Personal Reflection)
notes.notes:
Hello again! I'm here to make an announcement about the game's release! Yes, it's closer than you think. And… sorry for the delay!!! 😃

I'm currently working on Bedev version 0.77 (Beta - Early Development, though it's not that "early" anymore since it's almost finished!). Here’s everything I’ve added and changed in just one day:

[olist]
 Settings button in the main menu
 Reworked the settings menu
 Added an explanation for everything in the settings menu!
 Reworking the levels, trying to make them longer but not boring!
 Improving graphics and textures
 Added a new graphics option called "Psycho" (this increases samples for everything—reflections, ray tracing, Lumen, etc.)
[/olist]

Now, about the delay in launching the game:
I'm really sorry for the delay. I've been through some difficult times. I don’t know if it’s worth mentioning, but here we go…


I fell into depression again. I couldn't even get out of bed. I spent my days in front of a screen, watching videos that just messed with my mind more and more, and I ended up forgetting about the game. My last real update was last year—the last time I actually added content. My most recent small update was on the 15th.

I was sexually harassed, threatened, bullied, and almost sexually abused by people I trusted too much. And that’s it. A lot more happened, but Steam's filter probably won’t let me say it.

I'm really sorry. The delay is all my fault!! But don’t worry, I plan to release the game this month!! 😃

notes.title: A Liminal Place Public Tessting Version Release Date.
notes.notes:
Main game will no longer be updated until chapter 2 releases.

Well, I created a free DLC for those who already have the game in their library. This DLC is called Public Testing Version. It is a beta test version with the entire Chapter 1 and part of Chapter 2 (Chapters 1 and 2 are a bit buggy), mechanics, and more. I will add more content every day/week, and while I update the DLC, the main game will no longer receive updates until I release Chapter 2.

The DLC will be released either tomorrow (08/02/2024) or next week.

notes.title: Announce About Long Support Version / LTS
notes.notes:
What is **LSV**?

LSV (Long Support Version) means it's a Long-Term Support version, meaning a RELEASE version that will stay up for a long time without updates.

So, this is the last game **RELEASE** update, the latest version without bugs.
I'll start uploading Experimental Builds instead of Official Release Builds / Versions. Expect UI, SFX, Visual, and Performance bugs.
